title: Mayer–Vietoris diagram for localized graded cohomology
statement:
Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], let $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For an open subscheme $W\subseteq Y$ and $n\ge0$ let $\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n}$ be the tensor power of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and for $n<0$ put $\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n}=(\mathcal L|_W^{\vee})^{\otimes(-n)}$ with $\mathcal L^{\vee}$ the dual of [def-sc-invertible-module]. For $p\ge0$ set $H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbb Z}H^p(W,\mathcal F|_W\otimes\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n})$ [pqf-def-cohomology], a graded module over $\Gamma_*(Y,\mathcal L)=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ via restriction, tensor product and multiplication of sections, and let $H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}$ be the degree-zero part of its localization at the homogeneous element $s$ of degree $1$. Let $W_s=W\cap Y_s$, with $Y_s$ the open subscheme where $s$ does not vanish [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and let $c^p_W:H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\to H^p(W_s,\mathcal F|_{W_s})$ be the canonical map sending $\xi/s^n$ to $s^{-n}\xi$. Let $U\subseteq Y$ be a quasi-compact open and $V\subseteq Y$ an affine open. Then $U_s\cap V_s=(U\cap V)_s$ and $U_s\cup V_s=(U\cup V)_s$, and there is a commutative diagram with exact rows
$$
\begin{array}{ccccccc}
\cdots\to H^{p-1}_*(U\cap V,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}&\to&H^p_*(U\cup V,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}&\to&H^p_*(U,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\oplus H^p_*(V,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}&\to&H^p_*(U\cap V,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\to\cdots\\
\downarrow{\scriptstyle c^{p-1}_{U\cap V}}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle c^p_{U\cup V}}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle c^p_U\oplus c^p_V}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle c^p_{U\cap V}}\\
\cdots\to H^{p-1}(U_s\cap V_s,\mathcal F)&\to&H^p(U_s\cup V_s,\mathcal F)&\to&H^p(U_s,\mathcal F)\oplus H^p(V_s,\mathcal F)&\to&H^p(U_s\cap V_s,\mathcal F)\to\cdots
\end{array}
$$
for all $p\ge0$ (with $H^{-1}=0$), in which the lower row is the Mayer--Vietoris long exact sequence of $\mathcal F|_{(U\cup V)_s}$ for the open cover $(U\cup V)_s=U_s\cup V_s$, and the upper row is the degree-zero part of the localization at $s$ of the direct sum over $n\in\mathbb Z$ of the Mayer--Vietoris long exact sequences of $\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n}$ for the open cover of $U\cup V$ by $U$ and $V$.

proof.text: Use nonvanishing_section_trivializes to obtain the open S. The intersection and union identities are the symmetric distributive lattice identities. Obtain delta, the initial injection, the exact lower row, and restriction naturality from module_mayerVietoris X.toRingedSpace.

Obtain c from quotient comparison descent and obtain a,b,d, their generator formulas, and the exact upper row from the fraction Mayer--Vietoris exactness theorem, applied to the same delta and its lower exactness witnesses.

Apply fraction comparison squares to the same c,a,b,d and delta, using their formulas and delta restriction naturality. Assemble all witnesses, the lower exact row, the upper exact row, and the three squares in the original existential and conjunction statement.
